changes.comment: ai-assist: both proxied entry points honor parameters they silently dropped. `tier` is resolved client-side and sent through the existing modelOverride field, so a frontier request no longer runs on the base model and an already-deployed proxy needs no update; on callProxiedCompletion, `adaptOptionalToNullable` also rides along in the structuredOutput projection and `usage` is read back from the proxy response through a new validating aiCompletionUsage converter. `endpoint` is now refused on both proxied paths rather than ignored — a proxy cannot confirm it honored it, and silently reaching the provider's default upstream would send the request somewhere the caller excluded. Use the direct entry point, or point the proxy itself at the intended upstream. Separately, the proxied stream's published contract now states which four of the seven IAiStreamEvent variants it carries.
